findings.evidence: `Comodule.pointsAction` is defined as `(generalLinearEquiv A (A ⊗[R] V)).toMonoidHom.comp (pointsRepresentation V).asGroupHom` (PointsAction.lean:44-47), so this is a pure round trip. Copies: Tannaka/SemisimplePoint.lean:62-66, Tannaka/JordanDecomposition.lean:339-343, Representation/SemisimplePoint.lean:94-99. grep for `toLinearEquiv_ofLinearEquiv` in ./mathlib hits only Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Equiv.lean:618 (AlgEquiv, unrelated); no such GL lemma exists in ./code.
findings.fix: Add one `@[simp]` lemma next to `Comodule.pointsAction_toLinearMap` in Representation/PointsAction.lean — e.g. `toLinearEquiv_ofLinearEquiv_pointsAction : (LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup.ofLinearEquiv (pointsAction V g)).toLinearEquiv = pointsAction V g` (or the more basic `ofLinearEquiv_pointsAction : ofLinearEquiv (pointsAction V g) = (pointsRepresentation V).asGroupHom g`) — and replace all three inline `have haction` blocks with it.
findings.issue: The fact `(ofLinearEquiv (Comodule.pointsAction M g)).toLinearEquiv = Comodule.pointsAction M g` is re-derived as a local `have` here, again at Tannaka/JordanDecomposition.lean:339-343 (a copy this PR touches instead of extracting), and in `generalLinearEquiv`-applied form at Representation/SemisimplePoint.lean:94-99. Each copy is stated with `generalLinearEquiv` and typechecks only through the MulEquiv-wrapper defeq.

findings.evidence: grep `cancel_epi\] at`: PointFaithful.lean:64, PointFaithful.lean:103, Tannaka/SemisimplePoint.lean:75 — each followed by `rw [cancel_mono] at happ` and `congrArg SemimoduleCat.Hom.hom happ`. `fgPointFactorNatIso_congr` (JordanDecomposition.lean:222-236) already provides only the easy direction of the same fact.
findings.fix: Factor the shared step into one lemma — both `fgPointNatIsoHom_hom_app` and `fgPointSemisimplePartNatIso_hom_app` have the form `eqToHom h ≫ e.toModuleIsoₛ.hom ≫ eqToHom h.symm`, so state `eqToHom h ≫ e₁.toModuleIsoₛ.hom ≫ eqToHom h.symm = eqToHom h ≫ e₂.toModuleIsoₛ.hom ≫ eqToHom h.symm ↔ e₁ = e₂` once (companion to the existing `fgPointFactorNatIso_congr`) and use it at all three sites.
findings.issue: Turning an equality of `Aut (FGComoduleCat.scalarExtensionFunctor …)` into an equality of underlying linear maps (`congrArg (·.hom.app M)` → `rw [cancel_epi] at happ` → `rw [cancel_mono] at happ` → `congrArg SemimoduleCat.Hom.hom` → `simp only [LinearEquiv.toModuleIsoₛ_hom, SemimoduleCat.hom_ofHom]`) is the third verbatim copy of this idiom, and nothing states why the `eqToHom` legs may be cancelled.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/GeneralLinearGroup/Basic.lean:68,72 give only `ofLinearEquiv_mul` and `ofLinearEquiv_inv`; grep for `ofLinearEquiv_one` returns nothing in ./mathlib or ./code. Lines 153-154 type-ascribe `ofLinearEquiv (… ^ n) = ofLinearEquiv … ^ n` to `map_pow (generalLinearEquiv K _).symm.toMonoidHom`, which only elaborates through that defeq.
findings.fix: Add `ofLinearEquiv_one : ofLinearEquiv (1 : M ≃ₗ[R] M) = 1` and `ofLinearEquiv_pow : ofLinearEquiv (f ^ n) = ofLinearEquiv f ^ n` (both `rfl`, matching Mathlib's `ofLinearEquiv_mul`/`ofLinearEquiv_inv`) in a TauCeti GeneralLinearGroup file, then rewrite with them at lines 122-123, 151-155 and 186-187 instead of relying on `generalLinearEquiv.symm.toMonoidHom` being definitionally `ofLinearEquiv`.
findings.issue: `isSemisimplePoint_one` closes `IsSemisimple (ofLinearEquiv (1 : _ ≃ₗ[K] _))` with `GeneralLinearGroup.isSemisimple_one`, which is stated for `(1 : GeneralLinearGroup K V)`, purely by wrapper unification. The same undocumented defeq (`generalLinearEquiv.symm` silently standing in for `ofLinearEquiv`) carries `hpow` at lines 151-154 and the `Commute` transport at lines 186-187, while `.inv` (line 132) and `.mul_of_commute` (line 184) correctly use the stated `ofLinearEquiv_inv`/`ofLinearEquiv_mul`.

summary: The round-trip `ofLinearEquiv`/`toLinearEquiv` fact is now re-derived inline in three places (one of which this PR edits), the eqToHom-cancellation component-extraction chain is copied a third time without documentation, and the identity/power/commute steps in the new point file rely on undocumented definitional equality between `generalLinearEquiv.symm` and `ofLinearEquiv` while sibling proofs in the same file use stated lemmas.
